title: Latent Bridge: Asking for Help Without Words
abstract: arXiv:2611.21301v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text-based model collaboration requires a large model to generate intermediate responses before a smaller model can use its guidance, adding large-model decoding cost to inference. We introduce POND (Prefill-Only, No-Decode), a method that uses a frozen large sender for prefill and a small receiver for all autoregressive decoding. A trainable bridge maps the sender's hidden states to additional attention keys and values, allowing the receiver to use these representations throughout generation. POND also supports periodic review, in which the sender processes the receiver's partial response and updates its guidance through additional prefill passes while preserving the receiver's existing KV cache. Across reasoning and coding benchmarks, POND improves receiver performance with senders from different model families. translated_title: 潜在桥梁：无需言语的求助
translated_abstract: 基于文本的模型协作要求大模型先生成中间响应，小模型才能利用其指导，这为推理过程增加了大模型的解码成本。我们提出POND（仅预填充、不解码）方法，使用冻结的大模型作为发送方进行预填充，并由小模型作为接收方完成所有自回归解码。一个可训练的桥梁将发送方的隐藏状态映射为额外的注意力键和值，使接收方在整个生成过程中都能利用这些表示。POND还支持周期性审查，即发送方处理接收方的部分响应，并通过额外的预填充过程更新其指导，同时保留接收方已有的KV缓存。在推理和编程基准测试中，POND在不同模型家族的发送方配合下均提升了接收方的性能。特别是，GLM-5.3与Qwen接收方配对时能提供与Qwen3.8-Max相当的增益，支持了效果……（原文截断）
tldr: POND通过可训练桥梁将冻结大模型的隐藏状态直接注入小模型的注意力机制，实现“仅预填充、不解码”的跨模型协作，使小模型在无需承担大模型解码成本的情况下显著提升推理与编程性能。
en_tdlr: POND enables efficient large-small model collaboration by injecting a frozen large model's hidden states into a small receiver's attention via a trainable bridge, eliminating large-model decoding costs while boosting reasoning and coding performance.
